prompt: If Princess Diana had been born three years earlier, who would have been Prime Minister when she was ten?
answer: If Princess Diana had been born three years earlier, on July 1, 1958, she would have turned ten in 1968. The British Prime Minister then was **Harold Wilson**, who served from 1964 to 1970.
